title: 矽鍺選擇性磊晶
summary: 以 4 階段、24 個工程工作包拆解選擇性磊晶、晶面、活化接觸，完成圖解、對照、敏感度分析、故障判別、量測規劃與驗收。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 work packages explore selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts through diagrams, comparisons, sensitivity studies, fault diagnosis, measurement plans and acceptance reviews.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的雙語概念實作課；每步交付可審查的工程證據。24 步是學習拆解，不代表晶圓廠的完整配方。自行設定的數值須標為假設。題目不含可直接操作的化學混配、設備設定或量產公差；照片與外部影片為代表媒體，不是假稱每步實拍。
scopeEn: Bilingual conceptual exercises based on public principles, with reviewable evidence at each step. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete fab recipe. Chosen numerical inputs must be labeled hypothetical. No directly operable chemical mixtures, equipment settings or production tolerances are supplied. Photos and external videos are representative media, not claimed as recordings of every step.

stages.title: 選擇性與晶格
stages.description: 在「選擇性與晶格」建立六項互補證據，逐一檢查材料、幾何、物理機制與適用限制。
stages.descriptionEn: Build six complementary evidence items for selectivity and lattice, checking materials, geometry, mechanisms and validity limits.

steps.title: 選擇性定義
steps.objective: 完成「選擇性定義」的因果圖，把選擇性磊晶、晶面、活化接觸中的相關限制連到可觀察證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete a causal diagram for define selectivity, connecting relevant limits in selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：選擇性定義。畫一張含作用前後狀態的原創圖；以箭頭標出本步原理中的因果關係；圈出一項仍需量測的未知量。判讀依據：在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define selectivity. Draw an original before/after diagram; mark the causal relationship in this step; circle one quantity still requiring measurement. Interpretation: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「選擇性定義」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define selectivity and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「選擇性定義」因果圖：圖中要有邊界、輸入、輸出與一項不能僅由圖決定的量。
steps.checkEn: Submit the causal diagram for define selectivity: Show boundaries, inputs, outputs and one quantity that the diagram alone cannot determine.

knowledge.title: 選擇性定義的原理
knowledge.text: 在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。
knowledge.textEn: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence.

knowledge.title: 本階段的機制與工程權衡
knowledge.text: 選擇性磊晶同時追求目標表面成長及非目標表面不成核，必須報告兩種表面的結果。
knowledge.textEn: Selective epitaxy requires growth on target surfaces and suppressed nucleation elsewhere; report both surface outcomes.

quiz.question: 評估「選擇性定義」時，哪項敘述可以採用？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is valid when evaluating define selectivity?
options: 在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。
沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。
厚度相同就代表介面電性相同。
optionsEn: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence.
Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle.
Equal thickness implies equal interface electrical quality.
quiz.explanation: 在矽上成長且在介電層抑制成核是兩個需驗證的條件。 選擇性磊晶同時追求目標表面成長及非目標表面不成核，必須報告兩種表面的結果。
quiz.explanationEn: Growth on silicon and suppressed dielectric nucleation both need evidence. Selective epitaxy requires growth on target surfaces and suppressed nucleation elsewhere; report both surface outcomes.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a controlled comparison for set germanium fraction, connecting relevant limits in selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：鍺比例。建立兩個只改一項條件的假想案例；分開記錄可觀察差異與推測原因；說明如何用本步原理區分兩者。判讀依據：鍺比例同時影響晶格、能帶及材料穩定性。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Set germanium fraction. Create two hypothetical cases differing in one condition; separate observations from proposed causes; use this step’s principle to distinguish them. Interpretation: Germanium fraction affects lattice, bands and material stability. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「鍺比例同時影響晶格、能帶及材料穩定性。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
steps.observationEn: Check whether the evidence supports: Germanium fraction affects lattice, bands and material stability. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「鍺比例」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for set germanium fraction and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「鍺比例」對照表：交出兩案例、固定條件、預期差異及一項可能混淆因素。
steps.checkEn: Submit the controlled comparison for set germanium fraction: Submit both cases, fixed conditions, predicted difference and one confounder.

steps.title: 種晶表面

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a sensitivity sketch for identify seed surfaces, connecting relevant limits in selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：種晶表面。選出本步的一項輸入及一項輸出；以自訂低、中、高三點畫趨勢；逐點標註假設，並寫出趨勢可能失效的條件。判讀依據：殘氧化層會阻礙預期晶體延續。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Identify seed surfaces. Select one input and output for this step; sketch a hypothetical low/mid/high trend; label assumptions and state when the trend may fail. Interpretation: Residual oxide impedes intended crystalline continuation. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「殘氧化層會阻礙預期晶體延續。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failure: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「種晶表面」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

steps.check: 交付「種晶表面」敏感度草圖：圖須有變數、單位或無因次定義、三個假設點及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit the sensitivity sketch for identify seed surfaces: Include variables, units or dimensionless definitions, three hypothetical points and validity limits.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete a fault-discrimination table for define opening geometry, connecting relevant limits in selective epitaxy, facets and activated contacts to observable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本步問題：開口幾何。假設本步預期結果未出現；提出兩個不同機制；為各機制選一個能支持或否定的觀察，避免只重複同一量測。判讀依據：側壁角及暴露晶面會影響最終晶面形貌。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Define opening geometry. Assume the expected result fails; propose two distinct mechanisms; choose an observation that supports or rejects each rather than repeating one measurement. Interpretation: Sidewall angle and exposed planes affect final facets. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「側壁角及暴露晶面會影響最終晶面形貌。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.failureEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define opening geometry and add discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 交付「開口幾何」故障判別表：至少列出兩個假說、各自的辨別證據及先檢查順序。
steps.checkEn: Submit the fault-discrimination table for define opening geometry: List two hypotheses, discriminating evidence for each and a check order.

steps.instruction: 本步問題：摻雜與成長。針對本步定義待測量及採樣位置；列出解析度、背景與重複性；設計一個見證或空白，並說明檢出限如何限制結論。判讀依據：原位摻雜可能改變成長動力學。引用列出的原始資料；若使用數值，清楚標成自訂教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Question for this step: Couple doping and growth. Define the measurand and sampling locations; list resolution, background and repeatability; design a witness or blank and explain detection-limit constraints. Interpretation: In-situ doping can change growth kinetics. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
steps.observation: 檢查結果是否能支持「原位摻雜可能改變成長動力學。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan for couple doping and growth: Provide sampling coordinates, units, controls and uncertainty sources.

Combine this step with earlier stage evidence; propose two independent acceptance criteria; name one hold condition and the next confirming action. Interpretation: Adjacent gates and underlying materials constrain thermal history. Cite the listed primary material; label any chosen numbers as hypothetical educational inputs.
